date: Feb 12, 2024; event_kind: scheduled_for_inclusion; Normalized state: SFI; Event role: State transition; Recorded at: 2024-02-12T15:36:22Z; Historical label: Included EIPs; Normalization rationale: The initial merged version of EIP-7600 lists EIP-6110 under 'Included EIPs'. ACDE#181 minutes state the cross-layer EIPs were 'moved... to include[d] once the CL devs plus one[d] them', and ACDC#126 (2024-01-25) records broadly positive CL client support for EIP-6110 in Electra. No single minuted moment of the CL '+1' between the draft PR (2024-01-18) and the merge (2024-02-12) was located, so the merged document is used as the definitive record. Pre-EIP-7723 'Included' = commitment to the upgrade's scope; normalized to scheduled_for_inclusion (see the 2024-09-27 section-rename evidence).; Source: Add EIP: Hardfork Meta - Pectra (EIP-7600 creation); Source URL: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/92daa1df9f48c0f1edf945ed516a1d696fadb5fc/EIPS/eip-7600.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/92daa1df9f48c0f1edf945ed516a1d696fadb5fc/EIPS/eip-7600.md

date: Sep 26, 2024; event_kind: scheduled_for_inclusion; Normalized state: SFI; Event role: Same-state record (no transition); Recorded at: 2024-09-26; Historical label: EIPs Scheduled for Inclusion (section renamed from 'EIPs Included'); Normalization rationale: ACDE#197 (2024-09-26) rescoped Pectra; the Meta EIP adopted EIP-7723's formal vocabulary and renamed 'EIPs Included' to 'EIPs Scheduled for Inclusion' (commit 1d4ce546, 2024-09-27, PR #8911). This EIP's membership carried over unchanged, so the event records the adoption of the new terminology for an unchanged state, not a state transition. occurred_at is the ACDE#197 call date; the commit landed the next day.; Source: AllCoreDevs (ACDE) #197 minutes, 2024-09-26; Source URL: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/blob/ecf2eecc74adc479cea38b3d3b9a670c320421b1/AllCoreDevs-EL-Meetings/Meeting%20197.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/blob/ecf2eecc74adc479cea38b3d3b9a670c320421b1/AllCoreDevs-EL-Meetings/Meeting%20197.md

date: Apr 19, 2024; value: 2; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2024-04-19T15:43:30+00:00; Change type: interface_or_data_structure; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Re-architects deposits as EIP-7685 requests ('put deposits into request struct, take 2'): adds 'requires: 7685' frontmatter and the DEPOSIT_REQUEST_TYPE (b'0') constant; removes the dedicated RLP deposits list from the block body and the deposits_root header field; deposit encoding becomes a typed EIP-7685 request; block validity restated over the EIP-7685 requests list.; Classification rationale: Fundamental change to the EL data structures and encoding; also introduces the EIP-7685 dependency (recorded as dependency event eip6110-dep-e2).; Confidence: high; Commit: 97a3ccbaed436e2be51929361b4961cfeb94a8c5; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/97a3ccbaed436e2be51929361b4961cfeb94a8c5; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/97a3ccbaed436e2be51929361b4961cfeb94a8c5

path.aria-label: date: Feb 12, 2024; Inclusion state: SFI; Event role: State transition; Recorded at: 2024-02-12T15:36:22Z; Historical label: Included EIPs; Normalization rationale: The initial merged version of EIP-7600 lists EIP-6110 under 'Included EIPs'. path.aria-label: date: Jan 19, 2024; value: 1; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2024-01-19T19:23:16+00:00; Change type: clarification; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Commit subject says 'Fix typos' but the change corrects the queue storage-slot arithmetic in normative pseudocode: slot stride changed from 2 to 3 per exit message and the four duplicated 'queue_storage_slot + 1' sload operands corrected to the intended '+1[0:32]' and '+2[0:16]' slots.; Classification rationale: Materially corrects the specified storage layout an implementer would follow; the prior pseudocode contradicted the documented 3-slots-per-exit design, so this is a substantive correction despite the 'typos' subject.; Confidence: high; Commit: 7eb97f37eb35408e91f2965c0c5292617d60ed4d; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/7eb97f37eb35408e91f2965c0c5292617d60ed4d; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/7eb97f37eb35408e91f2965c0c5292617d60ed4d

date: Mar 25, 2024; value: 2; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2024-03-25T18:48:35+08:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Converts the mechanism from a stateful precompile to a deployed system contract: names VALIDATOR_EXIT_ADDRESS and SYSTEM_ADDRESS, defines three contract code paths (add exit, excess-exits getter, system process), removes the excess-return gas stipend, adds contract bytecode/deployment, and adds lightclient as author.; Classification rationale: Major redesign of the core mechanism (402 insertions / 165 deletions) changing how clients implement and invoke it.; Confidence: high; Commit: 35589d35c40576d932923542b31a4d8f7812c3e7; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/35589d35c40576d932923542b31a4d8f7812c3e7; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/35589d35c40576d932923542b31a4d8f7812c3e7

date: Apr 19, 2024; value: 3; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2024-04-19T11:54:24-06:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Adds support for partial withdrawals (PR #8406): renames the mechanism from 'exits' to 'withdrawal requests' throughout (title, constants, contract name), adds the uint64 'amount' field to the request operation, and changes the predeploy address.; Classification rationale: Extends normative functionality (partial withdrawals) and changes the operation's data structure and constants.; Confidence: high; Commit: 967e58e57a901cb4412a56d8e706d61717ffd402; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/967e58e57a901cb4412a56d8e706d61717ffd402; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/967e58e57a901cb4412a56d8e706d61717ffd402

date: Apr 19, 2024; value: 4; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2024-04-19T14:53:19-06:00; Change type: dependency; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Converts the EIP to use the EIP-7685 general-purpose execution-layer requests framework (PR #8469): adds 'requires: 7685' to the frontmatter, introduces WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST_TYPE 0x01, replaces the standalone RLP block-body/header extension with EIP-7685 request encoding, and deletes the block-structure section.; Classification rationale: Introduces an explicit cross-EIP dependency and restructures the request encoding and block integration around it.; Confidence: high; Commit: 1536db76e9d76056cd3d8d734cb865c5de9f087c; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/1536db76e9d76056cd3d8d734cb865c5de9f087c; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/1536db76e9d76056cd3d8d734cb865c5de9f087c

path.aria-label: date: Feb 12, 2024; Inclusion state: SFI; Event role: State transition; Recorded at: 2024-02-12T15:36:22Z; Historical label: Included EIPs; Normalization rationale: The initial merged version of EIP-7600 lists EIP-7002 under 'Included EIPs'. ACDE#181 minutes state the cross-layer EIPs were 'moved... to include[d] once the CL devs plus one[d] them', and ACDC#126 (2024-01-25) records broadly positive CL client support for EIP-7002 in Electra. No single minuted moment of the CL '+1' between the draft PR (2024-01-18) and the merge (2024-02-12) was located, so the merged document is used as the definitive record. date: Nov 18, 2024; value: 9; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2024-11-18T09:33:12+00:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Contract assembly restructured around the excess-inhibitor check: the zero-length getter branch and the 96-byte length check are folded into the fee computation path, an explicit callvalue check is added before returning the fee, the queue read loop is rewritten, and the deployment transaction, sender and derived address are regenerated (address 0x0046BB33B9eA028AE30BAd20702e36Ea8099BBbb).; Classification rationale: Rewrites the normative contract code paths and changes the bytecode and address.; Confidence: high; Commit: 16a12dcf41251c592f74042b6aa5727097f60167; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/16a12dcf41251c592f74042b6aa5727097f60167/EIPS/eip-7251.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/16a12dcf41251c592f74042b6aa5727097f60167/EIPS/eip-7251.md

date: Nov 27, 2024; value: 10; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2024-11-27T16:56:13+08:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: The 'Excess Consolidation Requests Getter' replaced by a 'Fee Getter': a zero-length input now returns get_fee() rather than the excess count; a 'Fee Overpayment' security section is added with a Solidity example that reads the fee before paying it and a note that CALLER must match the 0x01 withdrawal credential; blank-line formatting restored throughout the assembly listing.; Classification rationale: Changes what the contract returns for zero-length input, altering its interface and normative behaviour.; Confidence: high; Commit: 6354028fa0cf96f12fc10a15d745799667275a5b; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/6354028fa0cf96f12fc10a15d745799667275a5b/EIPS/eip-7251.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/6354028fa0cf96f12fc10a15d745799667275a5b/EIPS/eip-7251.md

date: Dec 09, 2024; value: 11; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2024-12-09T22:30:53+08:00; Change type: parameter; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: CONSOLIDATION_REQUEST_PREDEPLOY_ADDRESS in the constants table changed from 0x01aBEa29659e5e97C95107F20bb753cD3e09bBBb to 0x0046BB33B9eA028AE30BAd20702e36Ea8099BBbb.; Classification rationale: Propagates the address derived in 16a12dcf into the constants table, completing that logical update.; Confidence: high; Commit: 1df873ff13ee4c297ed7a1b3c81346c2636adc1d; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/1df873ff13ee4c297ed7a1b3c81346c2636adc1d/EIPS/eip-7251.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/1df873ff13ee4c297ed7a1b3c81346c2636adc1d/EIPS/eip-7251.md

date: Dec 09, 2024; value: 11; semantic_effect: non_substantive; Committed (UTC): 2024-12-10T00:20:25+08:00; Change type: clarification; Semantic effect: non_substantive; Summary: Add-request step 1 reworded from 'Ensure enough ETH was sent to cover the current consolidation request fee (check_fee())' to '(msg.value >= get_fee())'.; Classification rationale: Aligns prose with the get_fee pseudocode already specified; no behaviour change.; Confidence: high; Commit: da2a86bf15044416e8eb0301c9bdb8d561feeb32; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/da2a86bf15044416e8eb0301c9bdb8d561feeb32/EIPS/eip-7251.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/da2a86bf15044416e8eb0301c9bdb8d561feeb32/EIPS/eip-7251.md

date: Dec 12, 2024; value: 12; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2024-12-12T11:50:00+00:00; Change type: parameter; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: MAX_CONSOLIDATION_REQUESTS_PER_BLOCK changed from 1 to 2, the corresponding assembly constants changed from 0x01 to 0x02, and the deployment transaction, sender and derived address regenerated (address 0x00431F263cE400f4455c2dCf564e53007Ca4bbBb).; Classification rationale: Changes a normative rate-limit parameter and the resulting contract bytecode and address.; Confidence: high; Commit: d30c4842ce9d65e4808f0e920109b4d9d71d1492; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/d30c4842ce9d65e4808f0e920109b4d9d71d1492/EIPS/eip-7251.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/d30c4842ce9d65e4808f0e920109b4d9d71d1492/EIPS/eip-7251.md

date: Dec 18, 2024; value: 12; semantic_effect: non_substantive; Committed (UTC): 2024-12-18T22:38:58+00:00; Change type: parameter; Semantic effect: non_substantive; Summary: The 'FORK_TIMESTAMP | TBD | Mainnet' row removed from the execution-layer constants table and the block-processing condition reworded from 'block.timestamp >= FORK_TIMESTAMP' to 'where this EIP is active'.; Classification rationale: Removes a placeholder parameter that never carried a value and restates activation generically; no behaviour change.; Confidence: high; Commit: 0080cdfb36d56637c3d4a48d4dba204949f8fee5; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/0080cdfb36d56637c3d4a48d4dba204949f8fee5/EIPS/eip-7251.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/0080cdfb36d56637c3d4a48d4dba204949f8fee5/EIPS/eip-7251.md

date: Jan 30, 2025; value: 13; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-01-30T22:11:40+08:00; Change type: parameter; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Final system-contract address set: CONSOLIDATION_REQUEST_PREDEPLOY_ADDRESS changed to 0x0000BBdDc7CE488642fb579F8B00f3a590007251 with the deployment transaction s value, hash and derived sender updated accordingly.; Classification rationale: Changes a normative deployment parameter that clients must hard-code.; Confidence: high; Commit: c4809fa2fac1d939b9bf5c0a15f4a8842b321525; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/c4809fa2fac1d939b9bf5c0a15f4a8842b321525/EIPS/eip-7251.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/c4809fa2fac1d939b9bf5c0a15f4a8842b321525/EIPS/eip-7251.md

date: Feb 07, 2025; value: 14; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-02-07T09:27:01+00:00; Change type: clarification; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Code-path 2 description corrected from 'Excess consolidation requests getter - if the input length is zero, return the current excess consolidation requests count' to 'Fee getter - if the input length is zero, return the current fee required to add a consolidation request'.; Classification rationale: Removes a stale description that contradicted the fee-getter behaviour introduced in 6354028f; materially clarifies the contract interface.; Confidence: medium; Commit: a7a091addac3d474aab001472b8e6a35cbe69dca; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/a7a091addac3d474aab001472b8e6a35cbe69dca/EIPS/eip-7251.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/a7a091addac3d474aab001472b8e6a35cbe69dca/EIPS/eip-7251.md

date: Feb 14, 2025; value: 15; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-02-14T03:16:16+00:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Status moved to Last Call (deadline 2025-02-21) together with substantial specification updates: the consensus-layer constant is renamed MAX_EFFECTIVE_BALANCE_ELECTRA; the standalone 'Block processing' section is folded into 'System Call' which now states the call happens at the end of block processing; the consensus-layer change list is revised (process_pending_balance_deposits -> process_pending_deposits, apply_deposit -> process_deposit with state.pending_deposits, is_aggregator item dropped, process_consolidation added, exit-churn usage limited to 256 ETH with the surplus deferred to consolidations) and now links the pinned consensus-specs Electra beacon-chain document; the rationale is restructured into headed sections, 'Removing the initial slashing penalty' becomes 'Making the initial slashing penalty negligible', a 'Consolidation contract parameter values' rationale explains TARGET=1 and MAX=2 and the 262,144-request queue limit, backwards compatibility is broadened beyond the consensus layer, and a 'Consolidation queue hard limit' security section is added.; Classification rationale: Renames a normative constant, revises the consensus-layer change list and adds new normative limits alongside the status change.; Confidence: high; Commit: 67bfa19fbce58a85919c521c9c95767e7311e886; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/67bfa19fbce58a85919c521c9c95767e7311e886/EIPS/eip-7251.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/67bfa19fbce58a85919c521c9c95767e7311e886/EIPS/eip-7251.md

date: Mar 03, 2025; value: 16; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-03-03T11:32:16+00:00; Change type: clarification; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Fee-overpayment guidance extended: the Solidity example gains a requestFeeLimit parameter and a revert when the read fee exceeds it, with a note that the fee can change significantly between transaction creation and inclusion.; Classification rationale: Changes the recommended integration pattern for submitting consolidation requests, which affects implementations built against the contract.; Confidence: medium; Commit: 38ce04bd5da13d450ed34eac9c51913850fa50f8; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/38ce04bd5da13d450ed34eac9c51913850fa50f8/EIPS/eip-7251.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/38ce04bd5da13d450ed34eac9c51913850fa50f8/EIPS/eip-7251.md

date: Apr 01, 2025; value: 17; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-04-02T03:40:03+08:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: System-call properties and failure directives added: the call is made at CONSOLIDATION_REQUEST_PREDEPLOY_ADDRESS as SYSTEM_ADDRESS with no calldata, requests must appear in the EIP-7685 list in the exact dequeued order, the call has a dedicated 30,000,000 gas limit excluded from block gas accounting, does not follow EIP-1559 fee-burn semantics, and the block MUST be invalid if the predeploy has no code or the call fails; 'insert_withdrawal_request_into_queue' corrected to 'insert_consolidation_request_into_queue'; new 'System Call failure' and 'Empty Code failure' security sections added.; Classification rationale: Adds normative block-validity conditions and gas-accounting rules for the system call.; Confidence: high; Commit: 2f2f5124962be20bf222d71613c2f415f1e62bbe; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/2f2f5124962be20bf222d71613c2f415f1e62bbe/EIPS/eip-7251.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/2f2f5124962be20bf222d71613c2f415f1e62bbe/EIPS/eip-7251.md

path.aria-label: date: Jun 09, 2024; value: 1; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2024-06-09T11:25:44+00:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Specification updated to the design that shipped: instead of removing AttestationData.index the field is set to a fixed zero, committee indexing moves to the outer Attestation container via committee_bits, and aggregation_bits capacity is increased to all committees in a slot; the spec link moves from the eip7549 feature branch to the pinned consensus-specs Electra beacon-chain document; the deprecation-strategy rationale switches from option 1 to option 2 to avoid complicating AttesterSlashing; new rationale sections justify reducing MAX_ATTESTATIONS (to 8) and MAX_ATTESTER_SLASHINGS (2 -> 1); motivation gains the block-packing argument; a 'First block after fork' security section is added.; Classification rationale: Replaces the core normative mechanism and adds parameter changes and new security analysis.; Confidence: high; Commit: 61e755645974fc9985f3928c62742ccf218dc947; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/61e755645974fc9985f3928c62742ccf218dc947/EIPS/eip-7549.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/61e755645974fc9985f3928c62742ccf218dc947/EIPS/eip-7549.md

date: Jan 25, 2025; value: 1; semantic_effect: non_substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-01-25T08:07:50+00:00; Change type: editorial; Semantic effect: non_substantive; Summary: Spelling and grammar pass: 'indexes' -> 'indices', 'outter' -> 'outer', 'to a fixed value of zero', 'still increasing', 'increases the voting capacity', 'list of participants' indices', 'on-chain', 'post-electra', backtick added around on_attestation, and related wording fixes.; Classification rationale: Spelling and grammar corrections only; no values or mechanisms changed.; Confidence: high; Commit: 90d1d5b1cc5bb6db6dcb0e841b92fd99ec14435e; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/90d1d5b1cc5bb6db6dcb0e841b92fd99ec14435e/EIPS/eip-7549.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/90d1d5b1cc5bb6db6dcb0e841b92fd99ec14435e/EIPS/eip-7549.md

date: Feb 14, 2025; value: 2; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-02-15T00:54:47+08:00; Change type: clarification; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Status moved to Last Call (deadline 2025-02-21) with Mikhail Kalinin added as author; a new rationale section 'Using Bitvector for committee_bits' explains that committee_bits is a Bitvector of MAX_COMMITTEES_PER_SLOT = 64 because Bitlist encoding would double its size, and that the state transition ensures correctness when fewer committees are active; the MAX_ATTESTATIONS and MAX_ATTESTER_SLASHINGS rationales gain links to assets/eip-7549/complexity_analysis.md; the inline EIP-7495 markdown link is replaced by plain text while the textual reference is retained.; Classification rationale: Materially clarifies the type and encoding of the committee_bits data structure, which implementers must match; the status change and the link adjustments accompany it.; Confidence: medium; Commit: bdd00778927f84d8b43165357637a285320c24a8; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/bdd00778927f84d8b43165357637a285320c24a8/EIPS/eip-7549.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/bdd00778927f84d8b43165357637a285320c24a8/EIPS/eip-7549.md

date: Apr 15, 2025; value: 3; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-04-15T03:30:38+00:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: The gossip section is rewritten: the two quoted beacon_attestation rules (IGNORE duplicate target epoch/validator index, REJECT invalid signature) are replaced by a single REJECT rule requiring the attester to be a member of the committee, and the mutation analysis is rewritten around that rule instead of the signature check.; Classification rationale: Changes the p2p validation rule the EIP relies on for mutation resistance, affecting implementation and the stated security argument.; Confidence: high; Commit: 24f814bc60838bc42896e6c5b8db31cb82a9b7c9; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/24f814bc60838bc42896e6c5b8db31cb82a9b7c9/EIPS/eip-7549.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/24f814bc60838bc42896e6c5b8db31cb82a9b7c9/EIPS/eip-7549.md

path.aria-label: date: Apr 17, 2024; value: 1; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2024-04-17T20:01:03+00:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: "Simplify cl behavior": removes the requirement that "A additional processing step is be added to process_execution_payload to iterate over and process all requests", leaving each proposal free to choose how to extend ExecutionPayload and "how and when the request is processed".; Classification rationale: Deletes a consensus-layer processing requirement and delegates the decision to each request-type proposal; changes what implementers must do.; Confidence: high; Commit: 0e0600ed164db7875be38548bfb26ec24ff78e01; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/0e0600ed164db7875be38548bfb26ec24ff78e01; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/0e0600ed164db7875be38548bfb26ec24ff78e01

date: Apr 18, 2024; value: 2; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2024-04-18T22:38:06+00:00; Change type: interface_or_data_structure; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Substantial specification build-out: renames the CamelCase types to snake_case (request_type / request_data / requests_root); adds a "Block structure" section appending a list of requests to the RLP block body; specifies requests_root computation with explicit compute_trie_root_from_indexed_data pseudocode; adds cross-type and intra-type ordering rationale sections; reflows the prose.; Classification rationale: Defines the block body structure and the header commitment computation that were previously only described in prose; changes the data structures implementers must produce.; Confidence: high; Commit: e2a66831fcc5984f478513ce298607e178c364e8; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/e2a66831fcc5984f478513ce298607e178c364e8; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/e2a66831fcc5984f478513ce298607e178c364e8

date: Apr 25, 2024; value: 2; semantic_effect: non_substantive; Committed (UTC): 2024-04-25T20:32:17+00:00; Change type: clarification; Semantic effect: non_substantive; Summary: "Clarify intra-type ordering": drops the claim that lexicographical ordering of the opaque byte data would be the only valid scheme, keeping the same rule that intra-type order is determined by each request type individually.; Classification rationale: Rationale-section rewording; the normative rule (intra-type order undefined here, set per request type) is unchanged.; Confidence: high; Commit: 67c96916b9714b8ddc917d56705f3f9dfb468126; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/67c96916b9714b8ddc917d56705f3f9dfb468126; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/67c96916b9714b8ddc917d56705f3f9dfb468126

date: May 21, 2024; value: 2; semantic_effect: non_substantive; Committed (UTC): 2024-05-21T23:08:10+08:00; Change type: editorial; Semantic effect: non_substantive; Summary: Two typo fixes in the Rationale: names the opaque array explicitly ("the bytes of `request_data` array from second byte on") and fixes the ungrammatical "authority on their own unilaterally catalyze and action" to "authority on their own to unilaterally catalyze an action".; Classification rationale: Grammar and wording fixes in non-normative rationale text.; Confidence: high; Commit: 2d06fd44d18f22c4b302e3237e9b8f4c5f6001b4; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/2d06fd44d18f22c4b302e3237e9b8f4c5f6001b4; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/2d06fd44d18f22c4b302e3237e9b8f4c5f6001b4

date: Jun 17, 2024; value: 2; semantic_effect: non_substantive; Committed (UTC): 2024-06-17T23:16:13+08:00; Change type: editorial; Semantic effect: non_substantive; Summary: Status frontmatter changed from Draft to Review.; Classification rationale: Process-metadata-only change.; Confidence: high; Commit: b27b3f1c1b8252d178c0a7d4bcf6480c8bcb2159; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/b27b3f1c1b8252d178c0a7d4bcf6480c8bcb2159; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/b27b3f1c1b8252d178c0a7d4bcf6480c8bcb2159

date: Sep 26, 2024; value: 3; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2024-09-25T20:07:15-06:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: "Change requests hash to flat hash" (PR #8854): replaces the Merkle-Patricia trie requests_root with a flat commitment, renaming the header field to requests_hash and defining compute_requests_hash(list) = keccak256(rlp.encode([rlp.encode(req) for req in list])); also rewords the opaque-byte-array rationale ("transaction payload" -> "request payload").; Classification rationale: Changes the header field name and the commitment algorithm; directly affects block validity computation.; Confidence: high; Commit: 73629679582e2f06f4abfcabfd1c7615bc65df08; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/73629679582e2f06f4abfcabfd1c7615bc65df08; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/73629679582e2f06f4abfcabfd1c7615bc65df08

date: Sep 26, 2024; value: 4; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2024-09-26T07:38:35-06:00; Change type: clarification; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: "Fix stale function name" (PR #8907): the assignment line still called compute_trie_root_from_indexed_data, removed by the previous commit; it now calls compute_requests_hash.; Classification rationale: Repairs the normative pseudocode left inconsistent by the flat-hash change so that the specified computation is unambiguous; same logical update as commit 73629679.; Confidence: medium; Commit: 4dc51ba1e3cdd63439247415da7edf36b32f9e79; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/4dc51ba1e3cdd63439247415da7edf36b32f9e79; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/4dc51ba1e3cdd63439247415da7edf36b32f9e79

date: Oct 07, 2024; value: 5; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2024-10-07T22:31:38+08:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: "Group requests into request-data": removes the block-body extension entirely (the header alone carries the commitment); redefines a `requests` object as request_type ++ request_data where request_data holds zero or more encoded request objects of that type; replaces the keccak256/RLP commitment with sha256(sha256(requests_0) ++ sha256(requests_1) ++ ...); updates the abstract and the ordering rationale accordingly.; Classification rationale: Changes the block structure, the grouping of requests, and the hash function and construction of the header commitment.; Confidence: high; Commit: a360757d75893fb9e7a9c37c98e05481d671f68f; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/a360757d75893fb9e7a9c37c98e05481d671f68f; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/a360757d75893fb9e7a9c37c98e05481d671f68f

date: Oct 07, 2024; value: 5; semantic_effect: non_substantive; Committed (UTC): 2024-10-07T21:41:32+00:00; Change type: editorial; Semantic effect: non_substantive; Summary: Removes a stray trailing backtick from the sha256 construction code block.; Classification rationale: Markdown formatting fix only.; Confidence: high; Commit: 5070adf3537d1d3b811f06124a112e3d8ea295e4; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/5070adf3537d1d3b811f06124a112e3d8ea295e4; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/5070adf3537d1d3b811f06124a112e3d8ea295e4

date: Nov 26, 2024; value: 6; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2024-11-26T21:42:50+08:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: "Exclude empty requests data in commitment": items whose request_data is empty (length 1, type byte only) are skipped when building the intermediate hash list; the intermediate list must be ordered by request_type ascending; the pseudocode is corrected to hash digests (m.update(sha256(r).digest())) over a Sequence[bytes] block_requests; adds a rationale explaining that a block with no requests then commits to sha256("").; Classification rationale: Changes which elements enter the commitment and therefore the value of requests_hash; directly affects block validity.; Confidence: high; Commit: 5ac0297b9ac29255e785ff305feea940db5ac6b4; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/5ac0297b9ac29255e785ff305feea940db5ac6b4; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/5ac0297b9ac29255e785ff305feea940db5ac6b4

date: Feb 13, 2025; value: 7; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-02-13T21:55:18+08:00; Change type: clarification; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: "Clarify the size of `request_type`": states that a `request_type` *byte* is prepended to request_data (previously unqualified); also fixes "will defines" to "will define".; Classification rationale: Pins down the width of the type prefix, which implementations must encode and parse; materially clarifies the wire format.; Confidence: high; Commit: 3fa94a7bc98d3a53e4fa54c7399b91a0d538b5ce; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/3fa94a7bc98d3a53e4fa54c7399b91a0d538b5ce; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/3fa94a7bc98d3a53e4fa54c7399b91a0d538b5ce

date: Dec 18, 2024; value: 3; event_kind: scheduled_for_inclusion; Normalized state: SFI; Event role: State transition; Recorded at: 2024-12-18T19:48:12Z; Historical label: EIPs Scheduled for Inclusion ('Add EIPs 7623 & 7691'); Normalization rationale: ACDC#147 (2024-12-12) agreed to remove EIP-7742 from Pectra and instead 'implement a doubling to the blob count in Pectra through a change to the genesis configuration in clients' (summary row 147.6); the change was formalized as EIP-7691 (already discussed by name on ACDE#201, 2024-12-05, regarding the blob base fee update fraction) and added directly to 'EIPs Scheduled for Inclusion' on 2024-12-18 (commit 6770dfdd, PR #9094), replacing EIP-7742. date: May 07, 2025; value: 4; event_kind: included; Normalized state: Included; Event role: State transition; Recorded at: 2025-05-07T10:05:11Z; Historical label: Included EIPs (Pectra mainnet activation, epoch 364032 / timestamp 1746612311); Normalization rationale: Pectra activated on Ethereum mainnet at the timestamp recorded in EIP-7600's Activation table (tentative mainnet time added 2025-04-03, commit 355b3350; 1746612311 = 2025-05-07T10:05:11Z).
